pirate.notes: Stand-ins until art lands. Block: wanted style 'pirate' (new id 13) = sun-bleached driftwood planks with rope bands and brass studs; uses 'forest' (bark slabs, closest wood) with a bleached body colour; shader branch NOT added. Topper: wanted anchor or friendly skull-and-bones; uses 'dome'. Island: palm, treasure chest and wrecked-ship plank rim/prop kinds do not exist; rim uses tree/shell/rock/tuft.

env_notes: biomes.*.env (WtIslandBuilder, design/art/style-techniques.md §2/§5): light = cookbook preset (key/fill/back colour+energy, ambient, saturation/contrast/brightness, shadow_tint); sky = backdrop shader extras (cloud, cloud_shade, mountains, mountain_amount, mesa_amount, mesa_top, mesa_rock, mesa_falls, cloud_bank, stars, nebula, nebula_a/b, sun); haze = horizon colour for distant props; cap/body/strata/tile = island paint; inlay = gold ring round the board; rock_glow/glow_color = lava cracks; rim = [{kind, tint, weight, scale, glow, tall, edge (spill over the rim), spacing}] kinds: tuft clover flower_white|lilac|pink|yellow bush mound shrub tree tree_white pine rock rubble pillar pillar_broken star blob gumdrop lollipop basalt lava_pool crystal mushroom coral shell gear; hang = [{kind, tint, count, size, glow}] kinds: root strand icicle stalactite lava_drip crystal_down; far = up to 6 landmarks: trees waterfall pine castle arch pillars planet mountain volcano candy crystals basalt; far_cap/far_rock/far_accent/far_stone/planet = landmark colours; falls = waterfall colours. `sky` (top, horizon, low) and `frame` stay at biome level.
